title: Decision in the Dark
description: Burkes offers a choice. Wren takes the lift—and finds a new way forward.

shots.title: Lights out in Kessler Ward

panel.caption: The grid drops at midnight. Every tower in Kessler Ward goes dark except the red emergency strips, and the trains stop where they stand.

shots.direction: Wide establishing shot: a city-wide blackout leaves red emergency strips. Mika holds a white medical case, urgently looking up toward the dark tower.

shots.title: Floor forty

panel.caption: On the fortieth landing her legs give out. A door opens and Kenji from 40C crouches beside her with a bottle of water. ‘Who's it for?’

shots.direction: Inside the stairwell on floor forty, Mika pauses exhausted. Kenji crouches beside her and offers water. Keep the medical case beside Mika.

shots.title: Kenji offers Mika a charged battery: powering the service lift coul…

panel.caption: Kenji offers Mika a charged battery: powering the service lift could speed her to Mrs. Ito, but powering the radio might help stranded neighbors.

shots.direction: Kenji offers the charged battery. Mika looks between a service-lift control and her radio, then deliberately takes the battery toward the lift. Show one decisive action.

shots.title: Powering the Service Lift

panel.caption: Mika inserts the charged battery to activate the service lift, the mechanical hum breaking the silence as the lift ascends toward floor eighty-one.

shots.direction: Mika seats the battery into the service-lift power socket. The panel wakes, the doors close and the lift begins rising. The medical case stays with her.

shots.title: Unexpected Obstruction

panel.caption: Halfway up, the service lift halts abruptly; an emergency stop triggered by debris blocking the shaft delays Mika's progress awkwardly in near-darkness.

shots.direction: The lift shudders and stops beneath debris in the shaft. Mika braces herself against the wall as the light flickers. The lift remains stopped.

shots.title: Decision in the Dark

panel.caption: Mika peers through the lift's small window and spots a shadowy maintenance hatch; she contemplates exiting the stalled lift to climb the last floors on foot or conserve battery for communication aid.

shots.direction: Mika peers through the small lift window and notices a maintenance hatch above and to the side. Her gaze moves from the hatch to the battery indicator. End on the unresolved choice; she has not escaped or reached Mrs. Ito.

title: In through the window
description: A bird of light, a cable bridge and a city that helps Mika cross.

shots.title: Lights out in Kessler Ward

panel.caption: The grid drops at midnight. Every tower in Kessler Ward goes dark except the red emergency strips, and the trains stop where they stand.

shots.direction: Wide establishing shot: the megablock towers lose power, leaving red emergency strips. Mika grips her white medical case and looks toward floor eighty-one.

shots.title: The billboard blinks back

panel.caption: A dead billboard flickers awake for one breath. A small bird of cyan light traces a path across the rooftops, along the one cable line that still carries power.

shots.direction: A broken billboard flashes awake. A tiny cyan bird of light arcs away across rooftop cables; Mika turns and follows its direction.

shots.title: Rei on the dish

panel.caption: The bird's path ends at a cable bridge. Rei waves from the satellite dish on the far tower, headphones on, calling out every loose rung over the radio.

shots.direction: Across a suspended cable bridge, Rei stands beside a satellite dish wearing headphones and gestures toward the safe rungs. Mika steps carefully onto the bridge.

shots.title: The bridge goes dark

panel.caption: Halfway across, the billboard's power fails. The bird flares once and breaks into sparks, and Mika is left holding the chain in the dark and the wind.

shots.direction: The guiding cyan bird bursts into sparks and goes out. The bridge sways in the wind; Mika grips its chain, keeping the medicine case close.

shots.title: A tower full of lights

panel.caption: Rei gets on every channel in the next tower. Window by window, people hold up their phones until the whole tower shines, and Mika can see every rung.

shots.direction: Window after window in the far tower lights with neighbours holding phones. Mika can see the rungs again and advances across the bridge.

shots.title: In through the window

panel.caption: At first light Mika swings in through Mrs. Ito's kitchen window on floor eighty-one. Mrs. Ito takes the case in both hands. ‘You came the long way.’

shots.direction: At dawn Mika climbs through Mrs. Ito’s kitchen window and hands her the medical case. Mrs. Ito receives it with both hands. Hold on the quiet relief.

title: Dawn on eighty-one
description: One neighbour calls the next. The whole tower carries the medicine home.

shots.title: Lights out in Kessler Ward

panel.caption: The grid drops at midnight. Every tower in Kessler Ward goes dark except the red emergency strips, and the trains stop where they stand.

shots.direction: The towers go dark. Mika looks up, holding the medical case.

shots.title: Eighty-one floors

panel.caption: No lift, no light. Mika takes the stairwell two steps at a time, her flashlight the only thing moving in the tower.

shots.direction: Mika races up the stairwell, her flashlight sweeping the steps.

shots.title: Floor forty

panel.caption: On the fortieth landing her legs give out. A door opens and Kenji from 40C crouches beside her with a bottle of water. ‘Who's it for?’

shots.direction: Kenji crouches beside an exhausted Mika and offers water.

shots.title: Every door left open

panel.caption: Kenji knocks on the next door, and that neighbor knocks on the next. Doors open on every landing, phones light the stairs, and a bird of light flies ahead to show the way.

shots.direction: Neighbours open their doors and light the stairs with their phones.

shots.title: Hand to hand

panel.caption: The neighbors form a chain, one person to a step. The case goes up hand to hand, floor after floor, while Mika gets her breath back and follows.

shots.direction: The medicine case passes from hand to hand up the tower.

shots.title: Dawn on eighty-one

panel.caption: The case reaches Mrs. Ito as the sun comes up and the city's lights blink back on. The bird of light settles on her windowsill, then fades into the morning.

shots.direction: Mrs. Ito receives the case as sunlight enters her apartment.
